instructions: Acquire the original selected execution results through the original handoff. Choose bounded status or requested file/page reads using actual preceding outcomes. Preserve partial bytes and native scores. Native paths expose the current resource filesystem: the exact attempt observation does not establish that current file bytes were produced by that attempt. Separate read windows are not an atomic file snapshot. The scientific parent interprets the returned records. Original work, resource and selector stay fixed. Only actual complete acquisition establishes this endpoint. Tool-specific and resource instructions are available through knowledge.search, knowledge.entry and knowledge.read. The tool_knowledge context identifies the run-frozen library. Retrieve sections when useful; these instructions do not select work, supply scientific evidence or add execution capabilities. Use the actual tool schemas and caller-owned configuration for execution. Knowledge reads use line coordinates, not scientific source-byte anchors. No manual read is mandatory. Launch software/resource instructions have their own run-frozen library: launch.instructions.search, launch.instructions.entry, launch.instructions.read and launch.instructions.select. The launch_instruction_library context gives its identity. Select any relevant sections from one or several entries; pass the returned selection as launch_instructions in the child assignment. selected_launch_instructions contains exact sections already selected for this assignment. Instructions describe ways to work; they do not select resources, enable tools, override caller constraints, establish current availability or supply scientific evidence. Inventory and fresh observations remain separate. No instruction read or selection is mandatory.
